Issue 8 · 2026-08-28

Apple Search Ads ad variations route paid taps to approved Custom Product Pages — campaign and ad-group product-page choice, ad→landing creative congruence, geo and language constraints. Paid routing layer after Issue 5 CPP, Issue 6 In-App Events, and Issue 7 PPO. Leave Search Match on default until CPP data exists. Not a fee change.

Issue 7 · 2026-08-27

Product Page Optimization (PPO) is Connect's organic experiment layer: treatment vs control on app icons, screenshots, or app preview videos against the default product page only — traffic split, conversion metric, 90-day cap, per-locale treatments. Separate from Issue 5 CPP (paid landing) and Issue 6 In-App Events (time-boxed campaign). Wait for any live event to end before starting PPO. Not a fee change.

Read Issue 7

Issue 6 · 2026-08-27

In-App Events (live in Connect since 2022) add a time-boxed event card and event details page on your product page, in search, and on Today/Games/Apps — the campaign layer after Issue 5 CPP. Per-locale name, short description, long description, and event image; App Review reviews each event. If you shipped one CPP, ship one event whose card copy matches that keyword intent — not a second CPP yet. Creative Assets 4+ ceiling applies to event media. Not a fee change.

Issue 5 · 2026-08-27

Custom Product Pages (up to 35 per app) let indie teams ship keyword-specific screenshot sets and unique URLs for Apple Search Ads — separate from Product Page Optimization. Use Connect keyword analytics from Issue 4 to pick which CPP to build first. Screenshot localization requires per-device, per-locale re-export — overlays baked into PNGs do not auto-translate. Creative Assets 4+ ceiling applies. Not a fee change.

Issue 4 · 2026-08-25

Apple published Creative Assets best practices on 2026-08-05 ahead of a fall launch with iOS 27 — product page headers, search results slots, and Asset Library submission. Storefront assets must meet a 4+ rating even when the app is higher. Connect keyword analytics (impressions, conversion, retention) live since 2026-07-01. Not a fee change.

Issue 3 · 2026-08-24

Brazil CADE required Apple to respond by Monday to Epic's complaint; Epic claims alternative distribution in Brazil takes 9 steps (EU ~6 steps); Apple Brazil pages still list 5% CTC on off-store digital goods. Not a new US rate.

Issue 2 · 2026-08-24

Apple filed a court-ordered proposal in Epic v. Apple for US link-out commissions — 15% standard, 10% for Video/News/Mini Apps and renewals, 5% Small Business Program. That is Apple's ask, not a published US rate.
